summary: Added an idempotent manager adapter that turns exact Go {error:string} frames into contextual throws across create/list/snapshot/dispatch/effects/complete/audit/dispose while preserving ordinary fake-manager values and this binding. Host and runtime now use the adapter; targeted host/runtime tests passed 19/19, the multi-root Node suite passed 29/29, syntax checks passed, and a raw Go/WASM host probe confirmed invalid dispatch error propagation. Full inherited runner, browser smoke, replay, and CI were not run.
